name: input-advances-intro
symbols_from_why: Runs against the PINNED BASE ROM: every symbol it reads is vanilla.
description: Proves the harness's INPUT path -- that keys named in a spec timeline actually reach the engine. Ten randomized-length A presses skip the intro and drive the boot state machine to the title screen and main menu. boot-progression.json runs the same ROM for the same span with NO input and never gets past MainCB2_Intro; the difference between the two progressions is the proof that emu:setKeys did something. Press and release lengths are randomized on purpose: an assertion that only holds for one exact scripted replay is an assertion about the replay, not about the game.

probes.why: gMain.callback2 again -- the same probe as boot-progression, so the only thing that differs between the two runs is the input.

assert.why: The engine stayed alive throughout; input did not hang it.

THE INPUT PROOF. CB2_InitTitleScreen and CB2_MainMenu are unreachable in this frame span without a button press -- the no-input run of boot-progression.json is still sitting in MainCB2_Intro at the same point. Reaching them proves the timeline's keys were delivered, in order, through emu:setKeys.
Five distinct screens under input vs three without it.
Every screen reached is a real symbol; nothing went off into garbage.
